blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO. Agusan del Sur — Eight Chinese nationals and 10 Filipino workers were arrested while heavy machinery and extraction equipment valued at P153.3 million were impounded following a multi-agency operation against an alleged illegal mining operation in Surigao City, Surigao del Norte, on Wednesday.
